reaction: Seeing the separate assemblies come together is satisfying, though text alone cannot establish how the artwork looks or feels to use.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sail brought the wheels and chassis together into the finished racer, with a clear motion reward.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the rear axle repeated the already predictable front-wheel assembly, though the instructions remained clear.

surprise.text: The straw became an axle with a wheel on one end; that clarified its role in the construction.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; choosing between identical-looking numbered wheels and bearings was arbitrary, but their fittings had clear roles.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter to see a more varied construction, although the repeated wheel fittings made this one somewhat predictable.
